claim.claim-text: 1. Method of operating an air treatment system of a rail vehicle (15), the air treatment system (12) treating air volumes supplied to a passenger compartment (14) of the rail vehicle (15), the method comprising:

- operating the air treatment system (12) in an anti-infection mode in which the air treatment system (12) provides an effect to reduce the risk of a viral infection of occupants of the rail vehicle (15), wherein the anti-infection mode comprises a temperature increase of the air treatment system (12) at least up to a predetermined temperature level and exposing air volumes treated by the system to said temperature level, wherein the temperature increase is provided in or by a at least one heatable unit of the air treatment system and is automatically activated, wherein automatic activation takes place when at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
• the rail vehicle is at standstill, • the rail vehicle is free of any persons.
characterised by the temperature level being at least 40° C.
3. Method according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the temperature increase is regularly activated.
4. Method according to claim 3, wherein the automatic activation takes place when at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
characterised by the anti-infection mode comprising reducing a share of air (C) that is recirculated by the air treatment system (12) within the passenger compartment (14) of the vehicle (15).
characterised by further including at least one of:

- increasing a volume of fresh air (F) being taken in from the surroundings, while not maintaining a previous ratio of fresh air and recirculated air; - reducing a volume of recirculated air (C), while not maintaining a previous ratio of fresh air (F) and recirculated air (C).
7. Rail vehicle (15) comprising an air treatment system (12) that is operable according to a method of any of claims 1 - 6.
